数据组件

数据表格 AsamDataTable

管理请求、分页和跨页选择，并复用表格展示能力。

数据表格 ​

管理请求、分页和跨页选择，并复用表格展示能力。

基础用法 ​

示例使用本地异步函数、显式分页参数构造器和 Row 响应转换。分页改变会请求对应切片，列和工具栏与当前数据使用同一份源码。

本地分页与跨页选择

展开源码
vue
<template>
	<AsamDataTable
		ref="table"
		:api="api"
		:query="query"
		:build-page-params="buildPageParams"
		:transform="transform"
		:row-key="rowKey"
		:page-size="2"
		:page-sizes="[2, 5]"
		selectable
		size="default"
		@selection-change="selection = $event"
	>
		<AsamTableColumn prop="id" label="编号" />
		<AsamTableColumn prop="name" label="名称" />
		<template #toolbar="{ selection: selected, loading, stale }">
			<span>已选 {{ selected.keys.length }} 项</span>
			<AsamButton
				native-type="submit"
				type="primary"
				:disabled="loading || stale"
				@click="table?.clearSelection()"
				>清空选择</AsamButton
			>
		</template>
	</AsamDataTable>
	<pre>{{ selection }}</pre>
</template>

<script lang="ts" setup>
import { ref } from 'vue';
import { AsamButton, AsamDataTable, AsamTableColumn } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type {
	AsamApiRequest,
	AsamPage,
	AsamPageRequest,
	AsamDataTableExpose,
	AsamTableSelection
} from '@asam-ui/ui';

defineOptions({ name: 'AsamDataTableBasicDemoExample' });
interface Row {
	id: number;
	name: string;
}
interface Query {
	text: string;
}
interface Params extends Query {
	currentPage: number;
	pageSize: number;
}

const query = { text: '' };
const table = ref<AsamDataTableExpose<Row>>();
const selection = ref<AsamTableSelection<Row>>({ keys: [], rows: [] });
const rows: Row[] = Array.from({ length: 6 }, (_, index) => ({
	id: index + 1,
	name: '记录 ' + (index + 1)
}));
const rowKey = (row: Row) => row.id;
const buildPageParams = (input: Query, page: AsamPageRequest) => ({ ...input, ...page });
const api: AsamApiRequest<Params, AsamPage<Row>> = async (params, context) => {
	context.signal.throwIfAborted();
	const matched = rows.filter((row) => row.name.includes(params.text));
	const start = (params.currentPage - 1) * params.pageSize;
	return { list: matched.slice(start, start + params.pageSize), total: matched.length };
};
const transform = (response: AsamPage<Row>) => response;
</script>
vue
<template>
	<AsamDataTable
		ref="table"
		:api="api"
		:query="query"
		:build-page-params="buildPageParams"
		:transform="transform"
		:row-key="rowKey"
		:page-size="2"
		:page-sizes="[2, 5]"
		selectable
		size="default"
		@selection-change="selection = $event"
	>
		<AsamTableColumn prop="id" label="编号" />
		<AsamTableColumn prop="name" label="名称" />
		<template #toolbar="{ selection: selected, loading, stale }">
			<span>已选 {{ selected.keys.length }} 项</span>
			<AsamButton
				native-type="submit"
				type="primary"
				:disabled="loading || stale"
				@click="table?.clearSelection()"
				>清空选择</AsamButton
			>
		</template>
	</AsamDataTable>
	<pre>{{ selection }}</pre>
</template>

<script setup>
import { ref } from 'vue';
import { AsamButton, AsamDataTable, AsamTableColumn } from '@asam-ui/ui';

defineOptions({ name: 'AsamDataTableBasicDemoExample' });

const query = { text: '' };
const table = ref();
const selection = ref({ keys: [], rows: [] });
const rows = Array.from({ length: 6 }, (_, index) => ({
	id: index + 1,
	name: '记录 ' + (index + 1)
}));
const rowKey = (row) => row.id;
const buildPageParams = (input, page) => ({ ...input, ...page });
const api = async (params, context) => {
	context.signal.throwIfAborted();
	const matched = rows.filter((row) => row.name.includes(params.text));
	const start = (params.currentPage - 1) * params.pageSize;
	return { list: matched.slice(start, start + params.pageSize), total: matched.length };
};
const transform = (response) => response;
</script>

请求与分页覆盖 ​

api 与 request 互斥；API 分支必须提供 buildPageParams，URL 分支使用 buildPageRequest 或 pageTarget。具体 Row 类型必须提供 transform，将响应转换为 AsamPage。查询、页码、页长与选中键属于数据层；pagination 仅配置分页外观，不能覆盖 total、currentPage、pageSize 或 disabled。数据层拥有 data 与 loading，不能再传静态 data。

选择、事件与实例 ​

selection-change 返回 { keys, rows } 的跨页快照，覆盖基础表格的行数组签名。getSelection 返回同样的快照，getSelectionRows 返回已解析行，clearSelection 清空跨页选择。toolbar 插槽接收 selection、loading、stale；使用 selection.keys 统计选择，不能把它当作行数组。基础表格的适用事件、插槽与实例仍以本站基础 API 为准。

完整表格实例与树半选 ​

组件转发当前基础表格的完整公开实例，包括 getHalfSelectionRows、columns、tableId、ns、layout 和 store；方法保持真实实例接收者，观察值随挂载和当前表格变化更新。ns、layout、store 等对象只用于只读观察，不承诺其内部命令为稳定的公共接口。

getHalfSelectionRows 返回当前原生树选择列中的半选行。下例使用 AsamTableColumn 的 selection 类型勾选一个子节点，读取父节点的半选状态。该原生选择列与 selectable 提供的 ASAM 跨页选择分别维护：getSelection、getSelectionRows、clearSelection、toggleRowSelection 和 toggleAllSelection 仍遵守本页跨页快照覆盖，不把原生半选数组伪装成跨页选中键。

原生实例与半选

展开源码
vue
<template>
	<AsamDataTable
		ref="table"
		:api="loadTree"
		:query="{}"
		:build-page-params="buildPageParams"
		:transform="transform"
		:page-size="10"
		:page-sizes="[10]"
		default-expand-all
	>
		<AsamTableColumn type="selection" width="54" />
		<AsamTableColumn prop="name" label="树节点" />
	</AsamDataTable>
	<p>使用上表原生选择列勾选一个子节点，再读取当前树的半选父节点。</p>
	<AsamButton type="primary" native-type="button" @click="readInstance">读取表格实例</AsamButton>
	<pre role="status">{{ observation }}</pre>
</template>

<script lang="ts" setup>
defineOptions({ name: 'AsamDataTableNativeInstanceDemo' });
import { ref } from 'vue';
import { AsamButton, AsamDataTable, AsamTableColumn } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { AsamDataTableExpose, AsamPage, AsamPageRequest } from '@asam-ui/ui';

interface Row {
	id: number;
	name: string;
	children?: Row[];
}

const table = ref<AsamDataTableExpose<Row>>();
const observation = ref({ halfSelected: [] as string[], tableId: '', columns: 0, selectedKeys: 0 });
const rows: Row[] = [
	{
		id: 1,
		name: '研发组',
		children: [
			{ id: 11, name: '组件实现' },
			{ id: 12, name: '独立验证' }
		]
	}
];
const buildPageParams = (_query: object, page: AsamPageRequest) => page;
const loadTree = async (): Promise<AsamPage<Row>> => ({ list: rows, total: rows.length });
const transform = (response: AsamPage<Row>) => response;

function readInstance(): void {
	if (!table.value) return;
	observation.value = {
		halfSelected: table.value.getHalfSelectionRows().map((row) => row.name),
		tableId: table.value.tableId,
		columns: table.value.columns.length,
		selectedKeys: table.value.getSelection().keys.length
	};
}
</script>
vue
<template>
	<AsamDataTable
		ref="table"
		:api="loadTree"
		:query="{}"
		:build-page-params="buildPageParams"
		:transform="transform"
		:page-size="10"
		:page-sizes="[10]"
		default-expand-all
	>
		<AsamTableColumn type="selection" width="54" />
		<AsamTableColumn prop="name" label="树节点" />
	</AsamDataTable>
	<p>使用上表原生选择列勾选一个子节点，再读取当前树的半选父节点。</p>
	<AsamButton type="primary" native-type="button" @click="readInstance">读取表格实例</AsamButton>
	<pre role="status">{{ observation }}</pre>
</template>

<script setup>
defineOptions({ name: 'AsamDataTableNativeInstanceDemo' });
import { ref } from 'vue';
import { AsamButton, AsamDataTable, AsamTableColumn } from '@asam-ui/ui';
const table = ref();
const observation = ref({ halfSelected: [], tableId: '', columns: 0, selectedKeys: 0 });
const rows = [
	{
		id: 1,
		name: '研发组',
		children: [
			{ id: 11, name: '组件实现' },
			{ id: 12, name: '独立验证' }
		]
	}
];
const buildPageParams = (_query, page) => page;
const loadTree = async () => ({ list: rows, total: rows.length });
const transform = (response) => response;
function readInstance() {
	if (!table.value) return;
	observation.value = {
		halfSelected: table.value.getHalfSelectionRows().map((row) => row.name),
		tableId: table.value.tableId,
		columns: table.value.columns.length,
		selectedKeys: table.value.getSelection().keys.length
	};
}
</script>

失败和重试 ​

error 返回 AsamDataError，success 返回 AsamPage。组件显示错误与过期状态，过期时分页和选中操作受限；reload({ force: true }) 强制重载，cancel() 取消当前请求。reload 返回 success、error 或 cancelled 分支，调用方应按 status 处理。

本站继承关系 ​

  • AsamTable：适用的基础展示、交互与公开 API。
  • AsamPagination：适用的基础展示、交互与公开 API。

本页数据来源、模型、事件和实例的覆盖规则优先；本站链接不扩大本组件公开契约。尺寸使用基础组件的 ASAM 尺寸规则，示例使用 default。

跨页选择、陈旧恢复与取消 ​

完整示例返回严格 list/total 分页结构，buildPageParams 明确合并查询和分页输入，rowKey 从行生成稳定标识。selection-change 和 getSelection/getSelectionRows 返回跨页快照；原生 row-click、sort-change 和列插槽保持展示语义，sort() 仅排序当前原生表格展示。请求失败保留旧成功页、显示原页数和 total，陈旧时禁止新选择并隐藏分页；恢复后重新启用。cancel 返回 cancelled，不能当作成功。toolbar 提供 loading/stale 与快照，append/empty 交给基础表格。示例接口在本地运行。

完整示例同时记录七个数据入口事件：update:currentPage/page-change 和 update:pageSize/page-size-change 保持数字；分页每页数量入口可在2/4之间切换。selection-change 记录跨页 keys/rows 快照，success 保留严格 list/total，error 保留结构化错误种类与消息。原生 row/sort 事件仍单独记录；不能将 ASAM 选择快照当作原生行数组。

跨页选择、陈旧恢复与取消

展开源码
vue
<template>
	<section>
		<AsamCollapse data-testid="paged-state-contract-case"
			><AsamCollapseItem name="auxiliary-content">
				<template #title><span>完整分页状态与生命周期</span></template>
				<AsamButton
					type="primary"
					native-type="button"
					:disabled="pagedStateContractBusy"
					@click="runPagedStateContract"
				>
					验证分页状态与生命周期
				</AsamButton>
				<div ref="pagedStateInjectionTarget" />
				<pre data-testid="paged-state-contract-result">{{
					JSON.stringify(pagedStateContractResult)
				}}</pre>
			</AsamCollapseItem></AsamCollapse
		>

		<AsamCheckboxItem v-model="failure">
			<!-- prettier-ignore -->

			模拟接口失败
		</AsamCheckboxItem>
		<AsamButton type="primary" native-type="button" @click="holdReload"
			>开始持有分页请求</AsamButton
		>
		<AsamButton type="primary" native-type="button" @click="releaseHeld"
			>完成持有分页请求</AsamButton
		>
		<AsamButton type="primary" native-type="button" @click="reload">强制重载</AsamButton>
		<AsamButton type="primary" native-type="button" @click="cancelSlow">取消慢请求</AsamButton>
		<AsamButton type="primary" native-type="button" @click="table?.clearSelection()"
			>清空全部选择</AsamButton
		>
		<AsamButton type="primary" native-type="button" @click="table?.sort('id', 'descending')"
			>按编号倒序</AsamButton
		>
		<AsamButton type="primary" native-type="button" @click="inspect">读取跨页选择</AsamButton>
		<AsamButton type="primary" native-type="button" @click="toggleFirst(true)"
			>选择当前页首行</AsamButton
		>
		<AsamButton type="primary" native-type="button" @click="toggleFirst(false)"
			>取消当前页首行</AsamButton
		>
		<AsamButton type="primary" native-type="button" @click="toggleFirst()"
			>切换当前页首行</AsamButton
		>
		<AsamButton type="primary" native-type="button" @click="toggleLast()"
			>选择当前页末行</AsamButton
		>
		<AsamButton type="primary" native-type="button" @click="table?.toggleAllSelection()"
			>切换当前页全选</AsamButton
		>
		<AsamDataTable
			ref="table"
			:api="api"
			:query="query"
			:build-page-params="buildPageParams"
			:transform="transform"
			:row-key="rowKey"
			:page-size="2"
			:page-sizes="[2, 4]"
			:pagination="{ layout: 'sizes, prev, pager, next, total' }"
			selectable
			border
			stripe
			size="default"
			@update:current-page="recordPage('update:currentPage', $event)"
			@update:page-size="recordPage('update:pageSize', $event)"
			@page-change="recordPage('page-change', $event)"
			@page-size-change="recordPage('page-size-change', $event)"
			@selection-change="recordSelection"
			@success="recordSuccess"
			@sort-change="sortEvents++"
			@row-click="rowEvents.push($event.id)"
			@error="recordError"
		>
			<AsamTableColumn prop="id" label="编号" sortable />
			<!-- @vue-generic {Row} -->
			<AsamTableColumn prop="name" label="成员">
				<template #default="{ row }">
					<span :data-row-id="row.id">{{ row.name }}</span>
				</template>
			</AsamTableColumn>
			<template #toolbar="{ loading, stale, selection: snapshot }">
				<p
					data-testid="table-toolbar"
					:data-slot-loading="String(loading)"
					:data-slot-stale="String(stale)"
					:data-slot-keys="JSON.stringify(snapshot.keys)"
					:data-slot-rows="JSON.stringify(snapshot.rows)"
				>
					已选 {{ snapshot.keys.length }}；loading={{ loading }}；stale={{ stale }}
				</p>
			</template>
			<template #append><p data-testid="table-append">成员只在本地生成</p></template>
			<template #empty><p>当前没有成员</p></template>
		</AsamDataTable>
		<p role="status">结果：{{ result }}；成功次数：{{ successes }}；{{ error }}</p>
		<pre data-testid="table-selection">{{ JSON.stringify(selection) }}</pre>
		<pre data-testid="table-observation">{{ JSON.stringify(observation) }}</pre>
		<pre class="lifecycle-events" data-testid="table-lifecycle-events">{{
			JSON.stringify(events)
		}}</pre>
		<pre data-testid="table-events">{{ JSON.stringify({ sortEvents, rowEvents }) }}</pre>
		<RowKeyContract />
		<NativeSlotsContract />
	</section>
</template>
<script lang="ts" setup>
import NativeSlotsContract from './NativeSlotsContract.vue';
import RowKeyContract from './RowKeyContract.vue';
defineOptions({ name: 'AsamDataTableLifecycleDemo' });
import { ref, computed, effectScope, createApp, defineComponent, h, nextTick } from 'vue';
import {
	AsamCollapse,
	AsamCollapseItem,
	AsamCheckboxItem,
	AsamButton,
	AsamDataTable,
	AsamTableColumn,
	createAsamDataRuntime,
	useAsamPagedData,
	provideAsamData,
	AsamDataFailure
} from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type {
	AsamRecord,
	AsamRowKey,
	AsamPagedInput,
	AsamPagedConfig,
	AsamPagedState,
	AsamRequestContext,
	AsamApiRequest,
	AsamPage,
	AsamPageRequest,
	AsamDataTableExpose,
	AsamTableSelection,
	AsamDataError
} from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { EffectScope } from 'vue';
interface Row {
	id: number;
	name: string;
}
interface Query {
	text: string;
}
interface Params extends Query, AsamPageRequest {}
const table = ref<AsamDataTableExpose<Row>>();
const query = { text: '' };
const failure = ref(false);
const slow = ref(false);
const held = ref(false);
const pendingReleases = new Set<() => void>();
function holdReload() {
	held.value = true;
	void reload();
}
function releaseHeld() {
	held.value = false;
	for (const finish of [...pendingReleases]) finish();
}
async function waitHeld(signal: AbortSignal) {
	signal.throwIfAborted();
	if (!held.value) return;
	await new Promise<void>((done, reject) => {
		const finish = () => {
			pendingReleases.delete(finish);
			signal.removeEventListener('abort', abort);
			done();
		};
		const abort = () => {
			pendingReleases.delete(finish);
			signal.removeEventListener('abort', abort);
			reject(signal.reason);
		};
		pendingReleases.add(finish);
		signal.addEventListener('abort', abort, { once: true });
		if (signal.aborted) abort();
	});
	signal.throwIfAborted();
}
const result = ref('');
const error = ref('');
const events = ref<{ name: string; payload: unknown }[]>([]);
function recordPage(
	name: 'update:currentPage' | 'update:pageSize' | 'page-change' | 'page-size-change',
	value: number
) {
	events.value.push({ name, payload: value });
}
function recordSelection(value: AsamTableSelection<Row>) {
	selection.value = value;
	events.value.push({
		name: 'selection-change',
		payload: { keys: [...value.keys], rows: value.rows.map((row) => ({ ...row })) }
	});
}
function recordSuccess(value: AsamPage<Row>) {
	pageRows.value = value.list;
	successes.value++;
	events.value.push({
		name: 'success',
		payload: { list: value.list.map((row) => ({ ...row })), total: value.total }
	});
}
function recordError(value: AsamDataError) {
	error.value = value.message;
	events.value.push({ name: 'error', payload: { kind: value.kind, message: value.message } });
}
const successes = ref(0);
const sortEvents = ref(0);
const rowEvents = ref<number[]>([]);
const pageRows = ref<readonly Row[]>([]);
const selection = ref<AsamTableSelection<Row>>({ keys: [], rows: [] });
const observation = ref<{ keys: readonly (string | number)[]; rows: readonly Row[] }>({
	keys: [],
	rows: []
});
const rows: Row[] = Array.from({ length: 6 }, (_, index) => ({
	id: index + 1,
	name: '成员 ' + (index + 1)
}));
const rowKey = (row: Row) => row.id;
const buildPageParams = (input: Query, page: AsamPageRequest) => ({ ...input, ...page });
const api: AsamApiRequest<Params, AsamPage<Row>> = async (params, context) => {
	await waitHeld(context.signal);
	await new Promise<void>((done) => setTimeout(done, slow.value ? 500 : 100));
	context.signal.throwIfAborted();
	if (failure.value) throw new Error('演示分页接口失败');
	const matched = rows.filter((row) => row.name.includes(params.text));
	const start = (params.currentPage - 1) * params.pageSize;
	return { list: matched.slice(start, start + params.pageSize), total: matched.length };
};
const transform = (page: AsamPage<Row>) => page;
async function reload() {
	const response = await table.value?.reload({ force: true });
	result.value = response?.status ?? 'cancelled';
	if (response?.status === 'success') error.value = '';
}
async function cancelSlow() {
	slow.value = true;
	const pending = table.value?.reload({ force: true });
	setTimeout(() => table.value?.cancel(), 30);
	result.value = (await pending)?.status ?? 'cancelled';
	slow.value = false;
}
function inspect() {
	const snapshot = table.value?.getSelection();
	observation.value = { keys: snapshot?.keys ?? [], rows: table.value?.getSelectionRows() ?? [] };
}
function toggleFirst(selected?: boolean) {
	const first = pageRows.value[0];
	if (first) table.value?.toggleRowSelection(first, selected);
}
function toggleLast() {
	const last = pageRows.value.at(-1);
	if (last) table.value?.toggleRowSelection(last, true);
}
type PagedContractInput = AsamPagedInput<AsamRecord, AsamRecord, AsamPage<AsamRecord>, AsamRecord>;
const pagedStateContractResult = ref<{ phase: string; state: Record<string, unknown> }[]>([]);
const pagedStateContractBusy = ref(false);
const pagedStateInjectionTarget = ref<HTMLElement>();
async function runPagedStateContract() {
	pagedStateContractBusy.value = true;
	pagedStateContractResult.value = [];
	const observations: { phase: string; state: Record<string, unknown> }[] = [],
		scopes: EffectScope[] = [];
	const record = (phase: string, state: Record<string, unknown>) =>
		observations.push({ phase, state });
	const attach = (
		config: AsamPagedConfig<AsamRecord, AsamRecord, AsamPage<AsamRecord>, AsamRecord>
	) => {
		const scope = effectScope();
		scopes.push(scope);
		const state = scope.run(() => useAsamPagedData(config));
		if (!state) throw Error('Missing paged state');
		return { state, scope };
	};
	const snapshot = (state: AsamPagedState<AsamRecord>) => ({
		ids: state.data.value.list.map((row) => row.id),
		total: state.data.value.total,
		loading: state.loading.value,
		error: state.error.value?.kind ?? null,
		errorMessage: state.error.value?.message ?? null,
		stale: state.stale.value,
		hasSucceeded: state.hasSucceeded.value,
		empty: state.empty.value,
		currentPage: state.currentPage.value,
		pageSize: state.pageSize.value,
		dataKeySet: state.dataKey.value !== null,
		requestKeySet: state.requestKey.value !== null,
		keysMatch: state.dataKey.value !== null && state.dataKey.value === state.requestKey.value,
		resolved:
			state.resolvedPage.value === null
				? null
				: {
						currentPage: state.resolvedPage.value.currentPage,
						pageSize: state.resolvedPage.value.pageSize,
						queryKeyNonempty: state.resolvedPage.value.queryKey.length > 0
					},
		selection: {
			keys: state.selection.value.keys,
			ids: state.selection.value.rows.map((row) => row.id)
		}
	});
	const build = (query: AsamRecord, page: AsamPageRequest): AsamRecord => ({
		...query,
		p: page.currentPage,
		s: page.pageSize
	});
	const gate = () => {
		let release: (value: AsamPage<AsamRecord>) => void = () => {
				throw Error('Missing gate');
			},
			reject: (cause: unknown) => void = () => {
				throw Error('Missing gate');
			};
		const promise = new Promise<AsamPage<AsamRecord>>((done, fail) => {
			release = done;
			reject = fail;
		});
		return { promise, release, reject };
	};
	const settle = async (check: () => boolean) => {
		for (let i = 0; i < 100 && !check(); i++) await Promise.resolve();
		if (!check()) throw Error('Paged state did not settle within microtasks');
	};
	try {
		const firstGate = gate(),
			nextGate = gate(),
			failedGate = gate(),
			emptyGate = gate(),
			jobs = [firstGate, nextGate, failedGate, emptyGate];
		let calls = 0,
			successes = 0,
			localErrors = 0,
			notifications = 0,
			successSame = false;
		const pageEvents: number[] = [],
			sizeEvents: number[] = [],
			selectionEvents: (readonly AsamRowKey[])[] = [],
			parameters: AsamRecord[] = [],
			contexts: Record<string, unknown>[] = [];
		const runtime = createAsamDataRuntime({
				scope: 'paged-contract',
				provider: {
					onError: () => {
						notifications++;
					}
				}
			}),
			owner = attach({
				source: {
					api: (params, context) => {
						parameters.push(params);
						contexts.push({
							scope: context.scope,
							epoch: context.epoch,
							signalAborted: context.signal.aborted
						});
						return jobs[calls++]!.promise;
					},
					query: { term: 'initial' },
					buildPageParams: build,
					currentPage: 2,
					pageSize: 2,
					defaultSelectedRowKeys: [1, '1', 'future'],
					immediate: false
				},
				runtime,
				onSuccess: (data) => {
					successes++;
					successSame = data === owner.state.data.value;
				},
				onError: () => {
					localErrors++;
				},
				onPageChange: (page) => pageEvents.push(page),
				onPageSizeChange: (size) => sizeEvents.push(size),
				onSelectionChange: (selection) => selectionEvents.push(selection.keys)
			}),
			state = owner.state;
		record('paged-state-complete-public-members-initial-default-keys-and-pagination', {
			members: Object.keys(state),
			snapshot: snapshot(state),
			calls,
			selectionEvents: [...selectionEvents]
		});
		const first = state.reload();
		record('paged-state-held-api-build-params-and-original-context', {
			snapshot: snapshot(state),
			calls,
			parameters: [...parameters],
			contexts: [...contexts]
		});
		const host = {
			list: [
				{ id: 1, name: 'Numeric', meta: { count: 1 } },
				{ id: '1', name: 'String', meta: { count: 1 } }
			],
			total: 6
		};
		firstGate.release(host);
		const firstResult = await first;
		host.list[0]!.meta.count = 9;
		record('paged-state-success-resolved-page-frozen-host-snapshot-and-callback', {
			snapshot: snapshot(state),
			status: firstResult.status,
			fromCache: firstResult.status === 'success' ? firstResult.fromCache : null,
			successes,
			successSame,
			frozen:
				Object.isFrozen(state.data.value) &&
				Object.isFrozen(state.data.value.list) &&
				Object.isFrozen(state.data.value.list[0]) &&
				Object.isFrozen(state.data.value.list[0]?.meta),
			hostCount: host.list[0]!.meta.count,
			snapshotCount: Reflect.get(Object(state.data.value.list[0]!.meta), 'count'),
			selectionEvents: [...selectionEvents]
		});
		state.clearSelection();
		state.toggleRowSelection(state.data.value.list[0]!);
		state.toggleRowSelection({ id: 'outsider' }, true);
		state.toggleRowSelection(state.data.value.list[1]!, true);
		state.selectPage([state.data.value.list[1]!]);
		const selection = state.getSelection();
		record('paged-state-selection-typed-keys-toggle-page-filter-and-frozen-snapshot', {
			snapshot: snapshot(state),
			samePublicSelection: selection === state.selection.value,
			frozen:
				Object.isFrozen(selection) &&
				Object.isFrozen(selection.keys) &&
				Object.isFrozen(selection.rows),
			selectionEvents: [...selectionEvents]
		});
		state.setCurrentPage(3);
		const pageChanged = snapshot(state),
			next = state.reload();
		nextGate.release({
			list: [
				{ id: 3, name: 'Third' },
				{ id: 4, name: 'Fourth' }
			],
			total: 6
		});
		await next;
		state.toggleRowSelection(state.data.value.list[0]!, true);
		state.selectPage([state.data.value.list[1]!]);
		record('paged-state-page-navigation-retains-cross-page-rows-and-selected-keys', {
			beforeReload: pageChanged,
			after: snapshot(state),
			parameters: [...parameters],
			pageEvents: [...pageEvents],
			sizeEvents: [...sizeEvents]
		});
		const original = Error('owned paged request failure'),
			failed = state.reload();
		failedGate.reject(original);
		const failure = await failed;
		const staleSelection = state.getSelection();
		state.toggleRowSelection(state.data.value.list[0]!, true);
		state.selectPage([]);
		const prevented = state.getSelection() === staleSelection;
		state.toggleRowSelection(state.data.value.list[1]!, false);
		record('paged-state-error-retains-data-and-blocks-stale-selection-additions', {
			snapshot: snapshot(state),
			status: failure.status,
			originalCause: state.error.value?.cause === original,
			notified: state.error.value?.notified,
			prevented,
			successes,
			localErrors,
			notifications
		});
		const empty = state.reload({ force: true });
		emptyGate.release({ list: [], total: 0 });
		await empty;
		const beforeClear = state.getSelection();
		state.clearSelection();
		const clearEvents = selectionEvents.length;
		state.clearSelection();
		record('paged-state-zero-total-resets-page-success-empty-and-idempotent-clear', {
			snapshot: snapshot(state),
			retainedKeyBeforeClear: beforeClear.keys,
			clearEventsUnchanged: selectionEvents.length === clearEvents,
			successes,
			localErrors,
			notifications,
			pageEvents: [...pageEvents]
		});
		owner.scope.stop();
		record('paged-state-disposal-stops-reload-and-scope-reissue', {
			status: (await state.reload()).status,
			calls
		});
		let liveCalls = 0;
		const liveApi = async (params: AsamRecord) => {
				liveCalls++;
				return { list: [{ id: params.term, name: 'Live' }], total: 100 };
			},
			liveQuery = ref({ term: 'one' }),
			liveSource = computed<PagedContractInput>(() => ({
				api: liveApi,
				query: liveQuery.value,
				buildPageParams: build,
				currentPage: 2,
				pageSize: 2
			})),
			live = attach({ source: liveSource, runtime: createAsamDataRuntime() }).state;
		await settle(() => live.hasSucceeded.value);
		live.toggleRowSelection(live.data.value.list[0]!, true);
		const initialLive = snapshot(live);
		liveQuery.value.term = 'two';
		await settle(() => live.data.value.list[0]?.id === 'two');
		const changedLive = snapshot(live);
		const beforeEcho = liveCalls;
		record('paged-state-immediate-reactive-query-resets-page-and-clears-selection', {
			initial: initialLive,
			changed: changedLive,
			calls: liveCalls,
			noChangeObservation: liveCalls === beforeEcho
		});
		const obsolete = gate(),
			latest = gate();
		let raceCalls = 0,
			raceCallbacks = 0;
		const raceQuery = ref({ term: 'old' }),
			raceApi = (params: AsamRecord) => {
				raceCalls++;
				return params.term === 'old' ? obsolete.promise : latest.promise;
			},
			race = attach({
				source: computed<PagedContractInput>(() => ({
					api: raceApi,
					query: raceQuery.value,
					buildPageParams: build,
					immediate: false
				})),
				runtime: createAsamDataRuntime(),
				onSuccess: () => {
					raceCallbacks++;
				}
			}).state;
		const oldPending = race.reload();
		raceQuery.value.term = 'new';
		const oldCancelled = await oldPending;
		await Promise.resolve();
		const newPending = race.reload();
		latest.release({ list: [{ id: 'new' }], total: 1 });
		await newPending;
		obsolete.release({ list: [{ id: 'old' }], total: 1 });
		await settle(() => !race.loading.value);
		record('paged-state-query-race-cancels-old-and-ignores-late-result', {
			old: oldCancelled.status,
			calls: raceCalls,
			callbacks: raceCallbacks,
			snapshot: snapshot(race)
		});
		let sizeCalls = 0;
		const sizeState = attach({
			source: {
				api: async () => {
					sizeCalls++;
					return { list: [{ id: 1 }], total: 100 };
				},
				buildPageParams: build,
				currentPage: 3,
				pageSize: 2,
				immediate: false
			},
			runtime: createAsamDataRuntime(),
			onPageChange: (page) => pageEvents.push(page),
			onPageSizeChange: (size) => sizeEvents.push(size)
		}).state;
		await sizeState.reload();
		sizeState.setPageSize(4);
		const sizedBefore = snapshot(sizeState);
		await sizeState.reload();
		sizeState.setPageSize(4);
		sizeState.setCurrentPage(2);
		const pagedBefore = snapshot(sizeState);
		await sizeState.reload();
		record('paged-state-size-reset-and-page-setters-prepare-manual-requests', {
			sizeBefore: sizedBefore,
			pageBefore: pagedBefore,
			final: snapshot(sizeState),
			calls: sizeCalls,
			sizeEvents: [...sizeEvents],
			pageEvents: [...pageEvents]
		});
		const correctionCalls: number[] = [];
		let correctionSuccess = 0;
		const correction = attach({
			source: {
				api: async (params) => {
					correctionCalls.push(Number(params.p));
					return { list: [], total: 3 };
				},
				buildPageParams: build,
				currentPage: 9,
				pageSize: 2,
				immediate: false
			},
			runtime: createAsamDataRuntime(),
			onSuccess: () => {
				correctionSuccess++;
			}
		}).state;
		const corrected = await correction.reload();
		record('paged-state-out-of-range-corrects-once-and-preserves-reload-promise', {
			status: corrected.status,
			calls: correctionCalls,
			successes: correctionSuccess,
			snapshot: snapshot(correction)
		});
		const repeatedCalls: number[] = [];
		const repeated = attach({
			source: {
				api: async (params) => {
					repeatedCalls.push(Number(params.p));
					return { list: [], total: repeatedCalls.length === 1 ? 3 : 1 };
				},
				buildPageParams: build,
				currentPage: 9,
				pageSize: 2,
				immediate: false
			},
			runtime: createAsamDataRuntime()
		}).state;
		const uncorrectable = await repeated.reload();
		record('paged-state-repeated-out-of-range-is-response-error-after-one-correction', {
			status: uncorrectable.status,
			calls: repeatedCalls,
			snapshot: snapshot(repeated)
		});
		const requests: Record<string, unknown>[] = [],
			urlRuntime = createAsamDataRuntime({
				provider: {
					pagination: { page: 'p', pageSize: 's' },
					request: async (request, context) => {
						requests.push({
							request,
							context: {
								scope: context.scope,
								epoch: context.epoch,
								signalAborted: context.signal.aborted
							}
						});
						return { list: [{ id: 1 }], total: 20 };
					}
				}
			});
		const urlDefault = attach({
			source: {
				request: { url: '/page-default', params: { host: 'base' } },
				query: { term: 'filter' },
				currentPage: 2,
				pageSize: 4,
				immediate: false
			},
			runtime: urlRuntime
		}).state;
		await urlDefault.reload();
		const urlData = attach({
			source: {
				request: {
					url: '/page-data',
					method: 'post',
					data: { host: 'body' },
					params: { untouched: true }
				},
				query: { term: 'body-query' },
				pageTarget: 'data',
				currentPage: 3,
				pageSize: 2,
				immediate: false
			},
			runtime: urlRuntime
		}).state;
		await urlData.reload();
		let customBuildCalls = 0;
		const urlCustom = attach({
			source: {
				request: { url: '/unused-base' },
				query: { term: 'custom' },
				buildPageRequest: (query, page) => {
					customBuildCalls++;
					return {
						url: '/custom-built',
						method: 'put',
						data: { term: query.term, page: page.currentPage, size: page.pageSize }
					};
				},

			} finally {
				if (mounted) app.unmount();
				host.remove();
			}
		}

		pagedStateContractResult.value = observations;
	} catch (cause) {
		pagedStateContractResult.value = [
			...observations,
			{
				phase: 'paged-state-contract-unexpected-failure',
				state: { message: cause instanceof Error ? cause.message : String(cause) }
			}
		];
	} finally {
		for (const scope of scopes) scope.stop();
		pagedStateContractBusy.value = false;
	}
}
</script>

<template>
	<AsamCollapse data-testid="row-key-boundary-case"
		><AsamCollapseItem name="auxiliary-content">

		</AsamCollapseItem></AsamCollapse
	>
</template>
<script lang="ts" setup>
import { ref, effectScope } from 'vue';
import {
	AsamCollapse,
	AsamCollapseItem,
	AsamButton,
	createAsamDataRuntime,
	useAsamPagedData,
	AsamDataFailure
} from '@asam-ui/ui';

const busy = ref(false);
const observations = ref<Record<string, unknown>[]>([]);
async function runRowKeyBoundary() {
	busy.value = true;
	observations.value = [];
	const results: Record<string, unknown>[] = [];
	try {
		const cases: { name: string; key: unknown; rows: object[]; valid: boolean }[] = [
			{ name: 'own-empty-string', key: 'id', rows: [{ id: '' }], valid: true },
			{ name: 'own-zero', key: 'id', rows: [{ id: 0 }], valid: true },
			{ name: 'own-negative', key: 'id', rows: [{ id: -1 }], valid: true },
			{ name: 'own-fraction', key: 'id', rows: [{ id: 1.5 }], valid: true },
			{ name: 'sync-string-callback', key: () => 'callback', rows: [{}], valid: true },
			{ name: 'sync-number-callback', key: () => 7, rows: [{}], valid: true },
			{ name: 'own-NaN', key: 'id', rows: [{ id: NaN }], valid: false },
			{ name: 'own-Infinity', key: 'id', rows: [{ id: Infinity }], valid: false },
			{ name: 'own-boolean', key: 'id', rows: [{ id: true }], valid: false },
			{ name: 'own-null', key: 'id', rows: [{ id: null }], valid: false },
			{ name: 'own-object', key: 'id', rows: [{ id: {} }], valid: false },
			{ name: 'missing-own-key', key: 'id', rows: [{}], valid: false },
			{ name: 'inherited-key', key: 'id', rows: [Object.create({ id: 8 })], valid: false },
			{ name: 'duplicate-key', key: 'id', rows: [{ id: 1 }, { id: 1 }], valid: false },
			{ name: 'async-resolved', key: async () => 1, rows: [{}], valid: false },
			{
				name: 'async-rejected',
				key: () => Promise.reject(Error('row-key-rejected')),
				rows: [{}],
				valid: false
			},
			{
				name: 'thenable-resolved',
				key: () => ({ then: (done: (value: number) => void) => done(1) }),
				rows: [{}],
				valid: false
			},
			{
				name: 'thenable-rejected',
				key: () => ({
					then: (_done: unknown, reject: (cause: Error) => void) =>
						reject(Error('row-key-thenable-rejected'))
				}),
				rows: [{}],
				valid: false
			},
			{
				name: 'callback-throws',
				key: () => {
					throw Error('row-key-thrown');
				},
				rows: [{}],
				valid: false
			}
		];
		for (const item of cases) {
			const scope = effectScope();
			let calls = 0;
			const state = scope.run(() =>
				Reflect.apply(useAsamPagedData, undefined, [
					{
						source: {
							api: async () => {
								calls++;
								return { list: item.rows, total: item.rows.length };
							},
							buildPageParams: () => ({}),
							rowKey: item.key,
							immediate: false
						},
						runtime: createAsamDataRuntime()
					}
				])
			);
			try {
				const result = await state.reload();
				const row = {
					phase: item.name,
					valid: item.valid,
					status: result.status,
					calls,
					errorKind: state.error.value?.kind ?? null,
					errorMessage: state.error.value?.message ?? null,
					dataLength: state.data.value.list.length,
					hasSucceeded: state.hasSucceeded.value,
					selection: state.getSelection()
				};
				if (item.valid) {
					state.toggleRowSelection(item.rows[0], true);
					row.selection = state.getSelection();
				}
				results.push(row);
			} finally {
				scope.stop();
			}
		}
		const scope = effectScope();
		let invalid = false;
		const state = scope.run(() =>
			Reflect.apply(useAsamPagedData, undefined, [
				{
					source: {
						api: async () => ({ list: [{ id: 9 }], total: 1 }),
						buildPageParams: () => ({}),
						rowKey: () =>
							invalid ? Promise.reject(Error('row-key-selection-rejected')) : 9,
						immediate: false
					},
					runtime: createAsamDataRuntime()
				}
			])
		);
		try {
			await state.reload();
			invalid = true;
			const errors: { operation: string; kind: string | null; message: string }[] = [];
			for (const operation of ['toggleRowSelection', 'selectPage']) {
				try {
					if (operation === 'toggleRowSelection')
						state.toggleRowSelection({ id: 9 }, true);
					else state.selectPage([{ id: 9 }]);
				} catch (cause) {
					errors.push({
						operation,
						kind: cause instanceof AsamDataFailure ? cause.kind : null,
						message: cause instanceof Error ? cause.message : String(cause)
					});
				}
			}
			const afterInvalid = state.getSelection();
			invalid = false;
			state.selectPage([{ id: 9 }]);
			results.push({
				phase: 'selection-synchronous-key-guard-and-recovery',
				errors,
				afterInvalid,
				recovered: state.getSelection()
			});
		} finally {
			scope.stop();
		}
		await new Promise<void>((done) => setTimeout(done, 20));
		observations.value = results;
	} catch (cause) {
		observations.value = [
			...results,
			{
				phase: 'unexpected-failure',
				message: cause instanceof Error ? cause.message : String(cause)
			}
		];
	} finally {
		busy.value = false;
	}
}
</script>

<script lang="ts" setup>
import { onBeforeUnmount, ref } from 'vue';
import {
	AsamCollapse,
	AsamCollapseItem,
	AsamButton,
	AsamDataTable,
	AsamTableColumn
} from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type {
	AsamApiRequest,
	AsamDataTableExpose,
	AsamPage,
	AsamPageRequest,
	AsamRequestContext
} from '@asam-ui/ui';

interface Row {
	id: number;
	name: string;
}
type Mode = 'empty' | 'row' | 'failure';
const table = ref<AsamDataTableExpose<Row>>();
const details = ref<HTMLDetailsElement>();
const opened = ref(false);
const query = {};
const mode = ref<Mode>('empty');
const customSlots = ref(true);
const layout = ref<'fixed' | 'auto'>('fixed');
const calls = ref(0);
const result = ref('unloaded');
let complete: (() => void) | undefined;
const buildPageParams = (_query: object, page: AsamPageRequest) => ({ ...page });
const api: AsamApiRequest<AsamPageRequest, AsamPage<Row>> = (
	_params: AsamPageRequest,
	context: AsamRequestContext
) =>
	new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
		calls.value++;
		const requested = mode.value;
		const clear = () => {
			context.signal.removeEventListener('abort', abort);
			complete = undefined;
		};
		const abort = () => {
			clear();
			reject(new Error('插槽请求已取消'));
		};
		context.signal.addEventListener('abort', abort, { once: true });
		complete = () => {
			clear();
			if (requested === 'failure') reject(new Error('插槽示例失败'));
			else
				resolve({
					list: requested === 'empty' ? [] : [{ id: 1, name: '插槽成员 1' }],
					total: requested === 'empty' ? 0 : 1
				});
		};
	});
async function load(next: Mode) {
	mode.value = next;
	result.value = 'pending';
	const outcome = await table.value?.reload({ force: true });
	result.value = outcome?.status ?? 'missing';
}
function release() {
	complete?.();
}
onBeforeUnmount(() => table.value?.cancel());
</script>

			:page-sizes="[2, 4]"

			selectable

			stripe
			size="default"
			@update:current-page="recordPage('update:currentPage', $event)"
			@update:page-size="recordPage('update:pageSize', $event)"

		<pre data-testid="table-selection">{{ JSON.stringify(selection) }}</pre>

		<pre class="lifecycle-events" data-testid="table-lifecycle-events">{{

		<RowKeyContract />
		<NativeSlotsContract />

<script setup>
import NativeSlotsContract from './NativeSlotsContract.vue';
import RowKeyContract from './RowKeyContract.vue';
defineOptions({ name: 'AsamDataTableLifecycleDemo' });
import { ref, computed, effectScope, createApp, defineComponent, h, nextTick } from 'vue';
import {
	AsamCollapse,
	AsamCollapseItem,
	AsamCheckboxItem,
	AsamButton,
	AsamDataTable,
	AsamTableColumn,
	createAsamDataRuntime,
	useAsamPagedData,
	provideAsamData,
	AsamDataFailure
} from '@asam-ui/ui';
const table = ref();
const query = { text: '' };
const failure = ref(false);
const slow = ref(false);
const held = ref(false);
const pendingReleases = new Set();
function holdReload() {
	held.value = true;
	void reload();
}
function releaseHeld() {
	held.value = false;
	for (const finish of [...pendingReleases]) finish();
}
async function waitHeld(signal) {
	signal.throwIfAborted();
	if (!held.value) return;
	await new Promise((done, reject) => {
		const finish = () => {
			pendingReleases.delete(finish);
			signal.removeEventListener('abort', abort);
			done();
		};
		const abort = () => {
			pendingReleases.delete(finish);
			signal.removeEventListener('abort', abort);
			reject(signal.reason);
		};
		pendingReleases.add(finish);
		signal.addEventListener('abort', abort, { once: true });
		if (signal.aborted) abort();
	});
	signal.throwIfAborted();
}
const result = ref('');
const error = ref('');
const events = ref([]);
function recordPage(name, value) {
	events.value.push({ name, payload: value });
}
function recordSelection(value) {
	selection.value = value;
	events.value.push({
		name: 'selection-change',
		payload: { keys: [...value.keys], rows: value.rows.map((row) => ({ ...row })) }
	});
}
function recordSuccess(value) {
	pageRows.value = value.list;
	successes.value++;
	events.value.push({
		name: 'success',
		payload: { list: value.list.map((row) => ({ ...row })), total: value.total }
	});
}
function recordError(value) {
	error.value = value.message;
	events.value.push({ name: 'error', payload: { kind: value.kind, message: value.message } });
}
const successes = ref(0);
const sortEvents = ref(0);
const rowEvents = ref([]);
const pageRows = ref([]);
const selection = ref({ keys: [], rows: [] });
const observation = ref({
	keys: [],
	rows: []
});
const rows = Array.from({ length: 6 }, (_, index) => ({
	id: index + 1,
	name: '成员 ' + (index + 1)
}));
const rowKey = (row) => row.id;
const buildPageParams = (input, page) => ({ ...input, ...page });
const api = async (params, context) => {
	await waitHeld(context.signal);
	await new Promise((done) => setTimeout(done, slow.value ? 500 : 100));
	context.signal.throwIfAborted();
	if (failure.value) throw new Error('演示分页接口失败');
	const matched = rows.filter((row) => row.name.includes(params.text));
	const start = (params.currentPage - 1) * params.pageSize;
	return { list: matched.slice(start, start + params.pageSize), total: matched.length };
};
const transform = (page) => page;
async function reload() {
	const response = await table.value?.reload({ force: true });
	result.value = response?.status ?? 'cancelled';
	if (response?.status === 'success') error.value = '';
}
async function cancelSlow() {
	slow.value = true;
	const pending = table.value?.reload({ force: true });
	setTimeout(() => table.value?.cancel(), 30);
	result.value = (await pending)?.status ?? 'cancelled';
	slow.value = false;
}
function inspect() {
	const snapshot = table.value?.getSelection();
	observation.value = { keys: snapshot?.keys ?? [], rows: table.value?.getSelectionRows() ?? [] };
}
function toggleFirst(selected) {
	const first = pageRows.value[0];
	if (first) table.value?.toggleRowSelection(first, selected);
}
function toggleLast() {
	const last = pageRows.value.at(-1);
	if (last) table.value?.toggleRowSelection(last, true);
}
const pagedStateContractResult = ref([]);
const pagedStateContractBusy = ref(false);
const pagedStateInjectionTarget = ref();
async function runPagedStateContract() {
	pagedStateContractBusy.value = true;
	pagedStateContractResult.value = [];
	const observations = [],
		scopes = [];
	const record = (phase, state) => observations.push({ phase, state });
	const attach = (config) => {
		const scope = effectScope();
		scopes.push(scope);
		const state = scope.run(() => useAsamPagedData(config));
		if (!state) throw Error('Missing paged state');
		return { state, scope };
	};
	const snapshot = (state) => ({
		ids: state.data.value.list.map((row) => row.id),
		total: state.data.value.total,
		loading: state.loading.value,
		error: state.error.value?.kind ?? null,
		errorMessage: state.error.value?.message ?? null,
		stale: state.stale.value,
		hasSucceeded: state.hasSucceeded.value,
		empty: state.empty.value,
		currentPage: state.currentPage.value,
		pageSize: state.pageSize.value,
		dataKeySet: state.dataKey.value !== null,
		requestKeySet: state.requestKey.value !== null,
		keysMatch: state.dataKey.value !== null && state.dataKey.value === state.requestKey.value,
		resolved:
			state.resolvedPage.value === null
				? null
				: {
						currentPage: state.resolvedPage.value.currentPage,
						pageSize: state.resolvedPage.value.pageSize,
						queryKeyNonempty: state.resolvedPage.value.queryKey.length > 0
					},
		selection: {
			keys: state.selection.value.keys,
			ids: state.selection.value.rows.map((row) => row.id)

	});
	const build = (query, page) => ({
		...query,
		p: page.currentPage,
		s: page.pageSize
	});
	const gate = () => {
		let release = () => {
				throw Error('Missing gate');
			},
			reject = () => {
				throw Error('Missing gate');
			};
		const promise = new Promise((done, fail) => {
			release = done;
			reject = fail;
		});
		return { promise, release, reject };
	};
	const settle = async (check) => {
		for (let i = 0; i < 100 && !check(); i++) await Promise.resolve();

	};
	try {
		const firstGate = gate(),
			nextGate = gate(),
			failedGate = gate(),
			emptyGate = gate(),
			jobs = [firstGate, nextGate, failedGate, emptyGate];
		let calls = 0,
			successes = 0,
			localErrors = 0,
			notifications = 0,
			successSame = false;
		const pageEvents = [],
			sizeEvents = [],
			selectionEvents = [],
			parameters = [],
			contexts = [];
		const runtime = createAsamDataRuntime({
				scope: 'paged-contract',
				provider: {
					onError: () => {
						notifications++;
					}
				}
			}),
			owner = attach({
				source: {
					api: (params, context) => {
						parameters.push(params);
						contexts.push({
							scope: context.scope,
							epoch: context.epoch,
							signalAborted: context.signal.aborted
						});
						return jobs[calls++].promise;
					},
					query: { term: 'initial' },
					buildPageParams: build,
					currentPage: 2,
					pageSize: 2,
					defaultSelectedRowKeys: [1, '1', 'future'],
					immediate: false
				},
				runtime,

			callsBeforeReload: manualBefore,
			callsAfterReload: manualCalls,
			final: snapshot(manual)
		});
		const epochGate = gate(),
			epochRuntime = createAsamDataRuntime({ scope: 'scope-before' }),
			epochContexts = [];
		let epochCalls = 0,
			epochSuccess = 0;
		const epochApi = async (_params, context) => {
				epochContexts.push({ scope: context.scope, epoch: context.epoch });
				epochCalls++;
				return epochCalls === 2
					? epochGate.promise
					: { list: [{ id: epochCalls }], total: 1 };
			},
			epochState = attach({
				source: {
					api: epochApi,
					buildPageParams: build,
					cache: { ttlMs: 10000 },
					immediate: false
				},
				runtime: epochRuntime,
				onSuccess: () => {
					epochSuccess++;
				}
			}).state;
		await epochState.reload();
		epochState.toggleRowSelection(epochState.data.value.list[0], true);
		const epochPending = epochState.reload({ force: true });
		epochRuntime.setScope('scope-after');
		const epochCancelled = await epochPending;
		await Promise.resolve();
		const epochReset = snapshot(epochState);
		epochGate.release({ list: [{ id: 'obsolete' }], total: 1 });
		await new Promise((done) => setTimeout(done, 0));
		const epochReload = await epochState.reload();
		record('paged-state-scope-epoch-invalidates-held-job-data-selection-and-cache', {
			status: epochCancelled.status,
			reset: epochReset,
			reloadStatus: epochReload.status,
			fromCache: epochReload.status === 'success' ? epochReload.fromCache : null,
			calls: epochCalls,
			successes: epochSuccess,
			contexts: epochContexts,
			final: snapshot(epochState)
		});
		let isolatedCalls = 0;
		const isolatedApi = async () => {
				isolatedCalls++;
				return { list: [{ id: isolatedCalls }], total: 1 };
			},
			isolatedRuntime = createAsamDataRuntime(),
			isolatedInput = {
				api: isolatedApi,
				buildPageParams: build,
				immediate: false
			},
			isolatedA = attach({ source: isolatedInput, runtime: isolatedRuntime }).state,
			isolatedB = attach({ source: isolatedInput, runtime: isolatedRuntime }).state;
		await Promise.all([isolatedA.reload(), isolatedB.reload()]);
		record('paged-state-uncached-consumers-have-separate-flights-and-request-keys', {
			calls: isolatedCalls,
			distinctKeys: isolatedA.requestKey.value !== isolatedB.requestKey.value,
			a: snapshot(isolatedA),
			b: snapshot(isolatedB)
		});
		const sharedCancelGate = gate();
		let sharedCancelCalls = 0;
		const sharedCancelInput = {
				api: () => {
					sharedCancelCalls++;
					return sharedCancelGate.promise;
				},
				buildPageParams: build,
				cache: { ttlMs: 10000 },
				immediate: false
			},
			sharedCancelRuntime = createAsamDataRuntime(),
			sharedCancelA = attach({
				source: sharedCancelInput,
				runtime: sharedCancelRuntime
			}).state,
			sharedCancelB = attach({
				source: sharedCancelInput,
				runtime: sharedCancelRuntime
			}).state;
		const ca = sharedCancelA.reload(),
			cb = sharedCancelB.reload();
		sharedCancelA.cancel();
		const cancelledShared = await ca;
		sharedCancelGate.release({ list: [{ id: 'shared' }], total: 1 });
		const cbResult = await cb,
			rejoined = await sharedCancelA.reload();
		record('paged-state-one-shared-consumer-cancel-preserves-peer-and-rejoins-cache', {
			cancelled: cancelledShared.status,
			peer: cbResult.status,
			rejoined: rejoined.status,
			rejoinedFromCache: rejoined.status === 'success' ? rejoined.fromCache : null,
			calls: sharedCancelCalls,
			a: snapshot(sharedCancelA),
			b: snapshot(sharedCancelB)
		});
		let ttlCalls = 0;
		const ttlState = attach({
			source: {
				api: async () => {
					ttlCalls++;
					return { list: [{ id: ttlCalls }], total: 1 };
				},
				buildPageParams: build,
				cache: { ttlMs: 25 },
				immediate: false
			},
			runtime: createAsamDataRuntime()
		}).state;
		await ttlState.reload();
		const ttlHit = await ttlState.reload();
		await new Promise((done) => setTimeout(done, 40));
		const ttlExpired = await ttlState.reload();
		record('paged-state-real-cache-ttl-hit-and-expiry', {
			calls: ttlCalls,
			hit: ttlHit.status === 'success' ? ttlHit.fromCache : null,
			expired: ttlExpired.status === 'success' ? ttlExpired.fromCache : null,
			snapshot: snapshot(ttlState)
		});
		let dateCalls = 0;
		const dateApi = async () => {
				dateCalls++;
				return { list: [{ id: 'date' }], total: 1 };
			},
			dateBuilder = () => ({ stamp: new Date('2026-01-01T00:00:00Z') }),
			dateUncached = attach({
				source: { api: dateApi, buildPageParams: dateBuilder, immediate: false },
				runtime: createAsamDataRuntime()
			}).state,
			dateCached = attach({
				source: {
					api: dateApi,
					buildPageParams: dateBuilder,
					cache: { ttlMs: 10000 },
					immediate: false
				},
				runtime: createAsamDataRuntime()
			}).state,
			dateCustom = attach({
				source: {
					api: dateApi,
					buildPageParams: dateBuilder,
					cache: { ttlMs: 10000, key: () => 'known-date' },
					immediate: false
				},
				runtime: createAsamDataRuntime()
			}).state;
		await dateUncached.reload();
		await dateCached.reload();
		await dateCustom.reload();
		record('paged-state-nonserializable-params-fallback-cache-error-and-custom-key', {
			calls: dateCalls,
			uncached: snapshot(dateUncached),
			cached: snapshot(dateCached),
			custom: snapshot(dateCustom)
		});
		const cacheGuards = [];
		for (const [name, key] of [
			['empty', () => ''],
			['number', () => 1],
			['async', async () => 'key'],
			[
				'throw',
				() => {
					throw Error('paged key throw');
				}
			]
		]) {
			let io = 0;
			const checked = Reflect.apply(attach, undefined, [
				{
					source: {
						api: async () => {
							io++;
							return { list: [], total: 0 };
						},
						buildPageParams: build,
						cache: { ttlMs: 100, key },
						immediate: false
					},
					runtime: createAsamDataRuntime()
				}
			]).state;
			const result = await checked.reload();
			cacheGuards.push({ name, status: result.status, io, snapshot: snapshot(checked) });
		}
		record('paged-state-custom-cache-key-synchronous-nonempty-string-guards', {
			cases: cacheGuards
		});
		const rowFunction = attach({
			source: {
				api: async () => ({ list: [{ key: 'row-function' }], total: 1 }),
				buildPageParams: build,
				rowKey: (row) => String(row.key),
				defaultSelectedRowKeys: ['row-function'],
				immediate: false
			},
			runtime: createAsamDataRuntime()
		}).state;
		await rowFunction.reload();
		record('paged-state-custom-row-key-function-resolves-default-selection', {
			keys: rowFunction.selection.value.keys,
			rows: rowFunction.selection.value.rows,
			snapshot: snapshot(rowFunction)
		});
		let getterBad = false,
			getterCalls = 0;
		const getterTick = ref(0),
			getterApi = async () => {
				getterCalls++;
				return { list: [{ id: 'getter' }], total: 1 };
			},
			getter = attach({
				source: () => {
					void getterTick.value;
					if (getterBad) throw Error('paged getter throw');
					return { api: getterApi, buildPageParams: build, immediate: false };
				},
				runtime: createAsamDataRuntime()
			}).state;
		await getter.reload();
		getterBad = true;
		getterTick.value++;
		await Promise.resolve();
		const getterFault = snapshot(getter);
		getterBad = false;
		getterTick.value++;
		await Promise.resolve();
		const getterRecovery = await getter.reload();
		record('paged-state-throwing-source-getter-retains-stale-data-and-recovers', {
			fault: getterFault,
			status: getterRecovery.status,
			calls: getterCalls,
			final: snapshot(getter)
		});
		let missingRuntime;
		try {
			useAsamPagedData({
				source: {
					api: async () => ({ list: [], total: 0 }),
					buildPageParams: build,
					immediate: false
				}
			});
			missingRuntime = { threw: false };
		} catch (cause) {
			missingRuntime = {
				threw: true,
				kind: cause instanceof AsamDataFailure ? cause.kind : null,
				message: cause instanceof Error ? cause.message : String(cause)
			};
		}
		record('paged-state-missing-runtime-is-config-error', missingRuntime);
		if (typeof document !== 'undefined' && pagedStateInjectionTarget.value) {
			let injected,
				injectedCalls = 0,
				mounted = false;
			const host = document.createElement('div'),
				app = createApp(
					defineComponent({
						setup() {
							injected = useAsamPagedData({
								source: {
									api: async () => {
										injectedCalls++;
										return { list: [{ id: 8 }], total: 1 };
									},
									buildPageParams: build,
									immediate: false
								}
							});
							const state = injected;
							return () =>
								h(
									'output',
									{ 'data-testid': 'paged-state-injected-output' },
									JSON.stringify(snapshot(state))
								);
						}
					})
				);
			pagedStateInjectionTarget.value.append(host);
			provideAsamData(app, {});
			try {
				app.mount(host);
				mounted = true;
				if (!injected) throw Error('Missing injected paged state');
				const noInitialRequest = injectedCalls === 0,
					before = snapshot(injected);
				await injected.reload();
				await nextTick();
				const after = snapshot(injected),
					rendered = host.querySelector('output') !== null,
					renderedSnapshot = JSON.parse(
						host.querySelector('output')?.textContent ?? '{}'
					);
				app.unmount();
				mounted = false;
				record('paged-state-mounted-app-injection-and-unmount-cleanup', {
					noInitialRequest,
					before,
					after,
					rendered,
					renderedSnapshot,
					calls: injectedCalls,
					cancelledReload: (await injected.reload()).status
				});
			} finally {
				if (mounted) app.unmount();
				host.remove();
			}
		}
		pagedStateContractResult.value = observations;
	} catch (cause) {
		pagedStateContractResult.value = [
			...observations,
			{
				phase: 'paged-state-contract-unexpected-failure',
				state: { message: cause instanceof Error ? cause.message : String(cause) }
			}
		];
	} finally {
		for (const scope of scopes) scope.stop();
		pagedStateContractBusy.value = false;
	}
}
</script>

	overflow: auto;

<template>
	<AsamCollapse data-testid="row-key-boundary-case"
		><AsamCollapseItem name="auxiliary-content">
			<template #title><span>公开分页行键边界</span></template>
			<AsamButton
				type="primary"
				native-type="button"
				:disabled="busy"
				@click="runRowKeyBoundary"
				>验证行键边界</AsamButton
			>
			<pre data-testid="row-key-boundary-result">{{ JSON.stringify(observations) }}</pre>
		</AsamCollapseItem></AsamCollapse
	>
</template>
<script setup>
import { ref, effectScope } from 'vue';
import {
	AsamCollapse,
	AsamCollapseItem,
	AsamButton,
	createAsamDataRuntime,
	useAsamPagedData,
	AsamDataFailure
} from '@asam-ui/ui';
const busy = ref(false);
const observations = ref([]);
async function runRowKeyBoundary() {
	busy.value = true;
	observations.value = [];
	const results = [];
	try {
		const cases = [
			{ name: 'own-empty-string', key: 'id', rows: [{ id: '' }], valid: true },
			{ name: 'own-zero', key: 'id', rows: [{ id: 0 }], valid: true },
			{ name: 'own-negative', key: 'id', rows: [{ id: -1 }], valid: true },
			{ name: 'own-fraction', key: 'id', rows: [{ id: 1.5 }], valid: true },
			{ name: 'sync-string-callback', key: () => 'callback', rows: [{}], valid: true },
			{ name: 'sync-number-callback', key: () => 7, rows: [{}], valid: true },
			{ name: 'own-NaN', key: 'id', rows: [{ id: NaN }], valid: false },
			{ name: 'own-Infinity', key: 'id', rows: [{ id: Infinity }], valid: false },
			{ name: 'own-boolean', key: 'id', rows: [{ id: true }], valid: false },
			{ name: 'own-null', key: 'id', rows: [{ id: null }], valid: false },
			{ name: 'own-object', key: 'id', rows: [{ id: {} }], valid: false },
			{ name: 'missing-own-key', key: 'id', rows: [{}], valid: false },
			{ name: 'inherited-key', key: 'id', rows: [Object.create({ id: 8 })], valid: false },
			{ name: 'duplicate-key', key: 'id', rows: [{ id: 1 }, { id: 1 }], valid: false },
			{ name: 'async-resolved', key: async () => 1, rows: [{}], valid: false },
			{
				name: 'async-rejected',
				key: () => Promise.reject(Error('row-key-rejected')),
				rows: [{}],
				valid: false
			},
			{
				name: 'thenable-resolved',
				key: () => ({ then: (done) => done(1) }),
				rows: [{}],
				valid: false
			},
			{
				name: 'thenable-rejected',
				key: () => ({
					then: (_done, reject) => reject(Error('row-key-thenable-rejected'))
				}),
				rows: [{}],
				valid: false
			},
			{
				name: 'callback-throws',
				key: () => {
					throw Error('row-key-thrown');
				},
				rows: [{}],
				valid: false
			}
		];
		for (const item of cases) {
			const scope = effectScope();
			let calls = 0;
			const state = scope.run(() =>
				Reflect.apply(useAsamPagedData, undefined, [
					{
						source: {
							api: async () => {
								calls++;
								return { list: item.rows, total: item.rows.length };
							},
							buildPageParams: () => ({}),
							rowKey: item.key,
							immediate: false
						},
						runtime: createAsamDataRuntime()
					}
				])
			);
			try {
				const result = await state.reload();
				const row = {
					phase: item.name,
					valid: item.valid,
					status: result.status,
					calls,
					errorKind: state.error.value?.kind ?? null,
					errorMessage: state.error.value?.message ?? null,
					dataLength: state.data.value.list.length,
					hasSucceeded: state.hasSucceeded.value,
					selection: state.getSelection()
				};
				if (item.valid) {
					state.toggleRowSelection(item.rows[0], true);
					row.selection = state.getSelection();
				}
				results.push(row);
			} finally {
				scope.stop();
			}
		}
		const scope = effectScope();
		let invalid = false;
		const state = scope.run(() =>
			Reflect.apply(useAsamPagedData, undefined, [
				{
					source: {
						api: async () => ({ list: [{ id: 9 }], total: 1 }),
						buildPageParams: () => ({}),
						rowKey: () =>
							invalid ? Promise.reject(Error('row-key-selection-rejected')) : 9,
						immediate: false
					},
					runtime: createAsamDataRuntime()
				}
			])
		);
		try {
			await state.reload();
			invalid = true;
			const errors = [];
			for (const operation of ['toggleRowSelection', 'selectPage']) {
				try {
					if (operation === 'toggleRowSelection')
						state.toggleRowSelection({ id: 9 }, true);
					else state.selectPage([{ id: 9 }]);
				} catch (cause) {
					errors.push({
						operation,
						kind: cause instanceof AsamDataFailure ? cause.kind : null,
						message: cause instanceof Error ? cause.message : String(cause)
					});
				}
			}
			const afterInvalid = state.getSelection();
			invalid = false;
			state.selectPage([{ id: 9 }]);
			results.push({
				phase: 'selection-synchronous-key-guard-and-recovery',
				errors,
				afterInvalid,
				recovered: state.getSelection()
			});
		} finally {
			scope.stop();
		}
		await new Promise((done) => setTimeout(done, 20));
		observations.value = results;
	} catch (cause) {
		observations.value = [
			...results,
			{
				phase: 'unexpected-failure',
				message: cause instanceof Error ? cause.message : String(cause)
			}
		];
	} finally {
		busy.value = false;
	}
}
</script>

<template>
	<AsamCollapse
		ref="details"
		data-testid="table-native-slots-case"
		@toggle="opened = details?.open ?? false"
		><AsamCollapseItem name="auxiliary-content">
			<template #title><span>默认列与 append／empty 插槽</span></template>
			<AsamButton type="primary" native-type="button" @click="load('empty')"
				>加载空页</AsamButton
			>
			<AsamButton type="primary" native-type="button" @click="load('row')"
				>加载成员</AsamButton
			>
			<AsamButton type="primary" native-type="button" @click="load('failure')"
				>使插槽分页失败</AsamButton
			>
			<AsamButton type="primary" native-type="button" @click="release"
				>完成插槽分页请求</AsamButton
			>
			<AsamButton type="primary" native-type="button" @click="customSlots = !customSlots"
				>切换自定义插槽</AsamButton
			>
			<AsamButton
				type="primary"
				native-type="button"
				@click="layout = layout === &#39;fixed&#39; ? &#39;auto&#39; : &#39;fixed&#39;"
			>
				切换汇总布局
			</AsamButton>
			<AsamDataTable
				v-if="opened"
				ref="table"
				:api="api"
				:query="query"
				:build-page-params="buildPageParams"
				:immediate="false"
				:page-size="2"
				show-summary
				:table-layout="layout"
			>
				<AsamTableColumn prop="name" label="插槽成员">
					<template #default="{ row }">
						<span data-testid="native-slot-row">{{ row.name }}</span>
					</template>
				</AsamTableColumn>
				<template v-if="customSlots" #append>
					<p data-testid="native-slot-append">分页之外的附加说明</p>
				</template>
				<template v-if="customSlots" #empty>
					<p data-testid="native-slot-empty">自定义空页说明</p>
				</template>
			</AsamDataTable>
			<pre data-testid="native-slot-result">{{ JSON.stringify({ result, calls }) }}</pre>
		</AsamCollapseItem></AsamCollapse
	>
</template>

<script setup>
import { onBeforeUnmount, ref } from 'vue';
import {
	AsamCollapse,
	AsamCollapseItem,
	AsamButton,
	AsamDataTable,
	AsamTableColumn
} from '@asam-ui/ui';
const table = ref();
const details = ref();
const opened = ref(false);
const query = {};
const mode = ref('empty');
const customSlots = ref(true);
const layout = ref('fixed');
const calls = ref(0);
const result = ref('unloaded');
let complete;
const buildPageParams = (_query, page) => ({ ...page });
const api = (_params, context) =>
	new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
		calls.value++;
		const requested = mode.value;
		const clear = () => {
			context.signal.removeEventListener('abort', abort);
			complete = undefined;
		};
		const abort = () => {
			clear();
			reject(new Error('插槽请求已取消'));
		};
		context.signal.addEventListener('abort', abort, { once: true });
		complete = () => {
			clear();
			if (requested === 'failure') reject(new Error('插槽示例失败'));
			else
				resolve({
					list: requested === 'empty' ? [] : [{ id: 1, name: '插槽成员 1' }],
					total: requested === 'empty' ? 0 : 1
				});
		};
	});
async function load(next) {
	mode.value = next;
	result.value = 'pending';
	const outcome = await table.value?.reload({ force: true });
	result.value = outcome?.status ?? 'missing';
}
function release() {
	complete?.();
}
onBeforeUnmount(() => table.value?.cancel());
</script>

独立分页状态与完整生命周期 ​

useAsamPagedData(config) 可供自定义表格消费同一分页协议。config.source 接受普通配置、 ref、computed 或同步 getter；显式 runtime 与 app 的 provideAsamData(app, provider) 均可提供请求环境。immediate: false 仅准备参数与键，调用 reload() 后才执行请求。 生命周期示例中的“完整分页状态与生命周期”包含 TS/JS 两种同源实现，验证成功、空结果、 失败、取消、参数变化、跨页选择、缓存和实际 app 注入与卸载。

配置 完整约束
api + buildPageParams builder 同步接收 query 与 { currentPage, pageSize }；api 返回 Promise，并接收原始请求 context
request 默认将 query 与分页参数合并到 params；provider 的 pagination 可指定参数名
pageTarget: 'data' 适用于非 GET 请求；基础 target、query 和分页参数不得重名
buildPageRequest 同步构造完整 URL 请求，与 pageTarget、buildPageParams 互斥
transform 同步返回 { list, total }，优先于 provider 的 adaptPage；自定义行类型必须提供 transform
queryKey 同步返回非空字符串，用于不能默认稳定序列化的 query；变化会重置页码并清空选择
cache false 或 { ttlMs, key? }；TTL 为正安全整数，key 同步返回非空字符串
rowKey 默认 'id'，也可使用字段名或同步函数；结果为字符串或有限数字，同页不得重复
defaultSelectedRowKeys 字符串/数字键保持类型区分，初次加载前可保留未知行键，后续遇到该行时补齐行快照
currentPage / pageSize 正安全整数；修改 pageSize 重置到第一页，受控值回显不重复请求

AsamApiPageSource<Q, P, R, T> 明确声明 api、query、分页参数 builder 与 transform。 AsamPagedInput<Q, P, R, T> 进一步区分 API、默认 URL 合并和自定义 URL builder 三种合法 组合。AsamPagedInputBase 描述共有字段，消费完整配置时应使用 AsamPagedInput 约束组合。 AsamPage<T>.list、total 与 AsamTableSelection<T>.keys、rows 为只读数据；数字 1 与字符串 '1' 是两个独立行键。

状态 / 方法 行为
data, loading, error, stale, hasSucceeded, empty 只读 refs；失败保留最后成功数据并标记 stale；empty 仅在当前成功、非加载、无错误且非 stale 的空页成立
dataKey, requestKey, resolvedPage 分别标识成功数据与待执行参数；resolvedPage 保存实际成功的页码、页大小及 queryKey
currentPage, pageSize, selection 只读 refs；通过方法修改分页与选择
reload({ force? }) 返回 success / error / cancelled 闭合结果；force 跳过缓存并共享同一个强制请求
cancel() 结算当前等待为 cancelled；其他共享消费者可继续，晚到结果不得回写取消者
setCurrentPage(page), setPageSize(size) 自动模式发起请求，手动模式准备新参数并标记旧数据 stale
getSelection(), clearSelection() 返回冻结快照；清空重复调用不再次发出选择变更
toggleRowSelection(row, selected?), selectPage(rows) 当前页增选仅采用当前成功数据，保留其他页选择；stale 期间阻止增选和整页选择，仍可取消已选行

响应总数为零时页码归一到 1；页码超出末页时最多纠正并请求一次，第二次仍越界返回 response 错误。query 或源身份变化会取消旧请求、清空选择并从第一页开始；等价 wrapper 与受控回显 保持当前请求。runtime 的 scope/epoch 失效会取消请求，清空数据、成功页与选择并淘汰缓存。 卸载所属作用域后 reload 返回 cancelled。

onSuccess 接收冻结的标准化页，onError 接收结构化错误，onPageChange、 onPageSizeChange 接收数字，onSelectionChange 接收完整只读选择快照。回调不代替宿主 自己的受控数据更新。

实例控制按钮通过 success.list 中的当前行调用 toggleRowSelection(row, true/false)，省略第二参数时切换这一行；toggleAllSelection() 只切换当前已加载页，保留其他页的选择。读取按钮分别调用 getSelection() 和 getSelectionRows()，比较跨页键与已解析行。陈旧页拒绝新增选择和当前页全选切换，仍允许取消已有选择及 clearSelection() 全局清空；恢复后重新启用新增选择。cancel() 只取消请求，保留调用方可见的原成功页和选择，reload 的 cancelled 返回值单独处理。

当前页的原生展示用途 ​

完整示例在同一数据入口组合固定表头/列、两层分组表头、列模板/自定义表头、序号、当前行高亮、原生排序与列筛选、展开内容、汇总、状态样式、状态单元格合并及溢出提示。sort/clearSort、clearFilter、toggleRowExpansion、setCurrentRow 操作当前原生表格，事件保留 Row；它们不会替调用方改变服务器 query 或发起新的分页请求。此例只有三个本地行，合并规则针对相邻的前两行；动态分组、排序和筛选组合时应由业务按实际可见行计算 spanMethod，不能照搬固定行号。汇总使用当前展示行，不表示服务器全量总计。

高度按钮演示 maxHeight=150 的滚动区和 height=310/maxHeight=310 的固定高度；布局按钮切换 tableLayout 的 fixed/auto，请求计数用于确认这些展示操作不重新请求。固定原生 2.14.7 将已设置的 maxHeight 改为 undefined 时仍保留原内联上限，因此本例恢复时显式设置相同的高度和上限。原生组件在 maxHeight 有值时固定使用 fixed 布局，因此 auto 分支同时不提供 maxHeight。

展示排序、筛选、展开与汇总

<script lang="ts" setup>
defineOptions({ name: 'AsamDataTableNativeFeaturesDemo' });
import { h, ref } from 'vue';
import { AsamButton, AsamDataTable, AsamTableColumn } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { AsamDataTableExpose, AsamPage, AsamPageRequest, AsamTableProps } from '@asam-ui/ui';

interface Row {
	id: number;
	name: string;
	amount: number;
	status: string;
	note: string;
}
const rows: Row[] = [
	{
		id: 1,
		name: '林一',
		amount: 10,
		status: '准备',
		note: '本地演示备注用于显示完整的原生溢出提示内容。'
	},
	{ id: 2, name: '陈二', amount: 20, status: '准备', note: '第二行备注' },
	{ id: 3, name: '许三', amount: 30, status: '进行', note: '第三行备注' }
];
const table = ref<AsamDataTableExpose<Row>>();
const loadedRows = ref<readonly Row[]>([]);
const currentKey = ref<string | number>();
const expandedKeys = ref<(string | number)[]>([]);
const sortEvents = ref(0);
const pageCalls = ref(0);
const filters = ref<Record<string, string[]>>({});
const expanded = ref<number | null>(null);
const current = ref<number | null>(null);
const merged = ref(false);
const height = ref<string | number | undefined>(310);
const maxHeight = ref<string | number>();
const layout = ref<'fixed' | 'auto'>('fixed');
const objectSpan = ref(false);
const defaultSpan = ref(false);
const constantClass = ref(false);
const renderVNode = ref(false);
const showSummary = ref(true);
const statusFilters = [
	{ text: '准备', value: '准备' },
	{ text: '进行', value: '进行' }
];
const buildPageParams = (_query: object, page: AsamPageRequest) => page;
const api = async (): Promise<AsamPage<Row>> => {
	pageCalls.value++;
	return { list: rows, total: rows.length };
};
const transform = (page: AsamPage<Row>) => page;
const index = (at: number) => at + 101;
const filterStatus = (value: string, row: Row) => row.status === value;
const summary: NonNullable<AsamTableProps<Row>['summaryMethod']> = ({ columns, data }) =>
	columns.map((column, at) =>
		at === 0
			? renderVNode.value
				? h('strong', { 'data-testid': 'summary-vnode-label' }, '合计')
				: '合计'
			: column.property === 'amount'
				? renderVNode.value
					? h(
							'span',
							{ 'data-testid': 'summary-vnode-total' },
							String(data.reduce((total, row) => total + row.amount, 0))
						)
					: String(data.reduce((total, row) => total + row.amount, 0))
				: ''
	);
const span: NonNullable<AsamTableProps<Row>['spanMethod']> = ({ row, column }) => {
	if (defaultSpan.value) return undefined;
	const rowspan =
		!merged.value || column.property !== 'status' ? 1 : row.id === 1 ? 2 : row.id === 2 ? 0 : 1;
	const colspan = rowspan === 0 ? 0 : 1;
	return objectSpan.value ? { rowspan, colspan } : [rowspan, colspan];
};
const rowClass: NonNullable<AsamTableProps<Row>['rowClassName']> = ({ row }) =>
	row.id === 3 ? 'native-status-row' : '';
const tooltip: NonNullable<AsamTableProps<Row>['tooltipFormatter']> = ({ row }) =>
	renderVNode.value
		? h('strong', { 'data-testid': 'tooltip-vnode-content' }, `${row.name}：${row.note}`)
		: `${row.name}：${row.note}`;
</script>

<script setup>
defineOptions({ name: 'AsamDataTableNativeFeaturesDemo' });
import { h, ref } from 'vue';
import { AsamButton, AsamDataTable, AsamTableColumn } from '@asam-ui/ui';
const rows = [
	{
		id: 1,
		name: '林一',
		amount: 10,
		status: '准备',
		note: '本地演示备注用于显示完整的原生溢出提示内容。'
	},
	{ id: 2, name: '陈二', amount: 20, status: '准备', note: '第二行备注' },
	{ id: 3, name: '许三', amount: 30, status: '进行', note: '第三行备注' }
];
const table = ref();
const loadedRows = ref([]);
const currentKey = ref();
const expandedKeys = ref([]);
const sortEvents = ref(0);
const pageCalls = ref(0);
const filters = ref({});
const expanded = ref(null);
const current = ref(null);
const merged = ref(false);
const height = ref(310);
const maxHeight = ref();
const layout = ref('fixed');
const objectSpan = ref(false);
const defaultSpan = ref(false);
const constantClass = ref(false);
const renderVNode = ref(false);
const showSummary = ref(true);
const statusFilters = [
	{ text: '准备', value: '准备' },
	{ text: '进行', value: '进行' }
];
const buildPageParams = (_query, page) => page;
const api = async () => {
	pageCalls.value++;
	return { list: rows, total: rows.length };
};
const transform = (page) => page;
const index = (at) => at + 101;
const filterStatus = (value, row) => row.status === value;
const summary = ({ columns, data }) =>
	columns.map((column, at) =>
		at === 0
			? renderVNode.value
				? h('strong', { 'data-testid': 'summary-vnode-label' }, '合计')
				: '合计'
			: column.property === 'amount'
				? renderVNode.value
					? h(
							'span',
							{ 'data-testid': 'summary-vnode-total' },
							String(data.reduce((total, row) => total + row.amount, 0))
						)
					: String(data.reduce((total, row) => total + row.amount, 0))
				: ''
	);
const span = ({ row, column }) => {
	if (defaultSpan.value) return undefined;
	const rowspan =
		!merged.value || column.property !== 'status' ? 1 : row.id === 1 ? 2 : row.id === 2 ? 0 : 1;
	const colspan = rowspan === 0 ? 0 : 1;
	return objectSpan.value ? { rowspan, colspan } : [rowspan, colspan];
};
const rowClass = ({ row }) => (row.id === 3 ? 'native-status-row' : '');
const tooltip = ({ row }) =>
	renderVNode.value
		? h('strong', { 'data-testid': 'tooltip-vnode-content' }, `${row.name}：${row.note}`)
		: `${row.name}：${row.note}`;
</script>

回调按钮分别演示汇总与 tooltip 的文本/VNode 返回值、spanMethod 的数组/对象跨度，以及 rowClassName 的字符串/泛型函数。spanMethod 返回 undefined 时使用原生默认跨度，可恢复全部默认单元格，再恢复合并。showSummary 可动态关闭并恢复；高度可使用数字或 CSS 字符串，未设置 height 时由 maxHeight 约束实际滚动区。clearFilter 接受省略参数、单个键或键数组，固定原生源码的签名比原文档表格仅列出的数组更完整。setCurrentRow 省略行时清除高亮，toggleRowExpansion 省略第二参数时切换展开；传入具体 Row 保留行类型。这些本地展示操作保持同一次分页请求，不代表服务器筛选或排序。

原生树加载与行键边界 ​

currentRowKey、expandRowKeys 和 updateKeyChildren 使用 rowKey 生成的原始 ASAM 键；数字 1 与字符串 "1" 分别定位，不要求调用方填写内部类型前缀。updateKeyChildren 遵守原生条件：lazy=true、已加载的父节点及新子行；它只更新当前原生树展示，不重写分页来源或跨页选择快照。Table 的原生 lazy/load 行加载与 Remote/Dict Cascader、TreeSelect 的完整树来源不同；后两者仍排除逐节点数据加载。setCurrentRow、toggleRowExpansion 使用当前实例的 Row；示例从 success.list/列插槽取得已规范化行，不能假定原 API 对象与实例行同一引用。

原生懒加载与数值/字符串行键

<script lang="ts" setup>
defineOptions({ name: 'AsamDataTableLazyTreeKeysDemo' });
import { ref } from 'vue';
import { AsamButton, AsamDataTable, AsamTableColumn } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { AsamDataTableExpose, AsamPage, AsamPageRequest, AsamTableProps } from '@asam-ui/ui';
interface Row {
	id: string | number;
	name: string;
	hasChildren?: boolean;
}
const table = ref<AsamDataTableExpose<Row>>();
const currentKey = ref<string | number>();
const pageCalls = ref(0);
const loads = ref<(string | number)[]>([]);
const api = async (): Promise<AsamPage<Row>> => {
	pageCalls.value++;
	return {
		list: [
			{ id: 1, name: '数字父节点', hasChildren: true },
			{ id: '1', name: '字符串父节点', hasChildren: true }
		],
		total: 2
	};
};
const buildPageParams = (_query: object, page: AsamPageRequest) => page;
const transform = (page: AsamPage<Row>) => page;
const load: NonNullable<AsamTableProps<Row>['load']> = (row, _treeNode, resolve) => {
	loads.value.push(row.id);
	resolve([
		{
			id: typeof row.id === 'number' ? 11 : '11',
			name: typeof row.id === 'number' ? '数字原子节点' : '字符串原子节点'
		}
	]);
};
function replace(key: string | number): void {
	table.value?.updateKeyChildren(key, [
		{
			id: typeof key === 'number' ? 12 : '12',
			name: typeof key === 'number' ? '数字新子节点' : '字符串新子节点'
		}
	]);
}
</script>

工具栏插槽的 selection 保留完整原始键和业务行快照，loading/stale 为布尔值；分页示例提供明确持有／完成请求操作，可观察加载中、失败过期和恢复的状态。默认插槽没有载荷参数，直接放置 AsamTableColumn；列内的 row 作用域属于列组件。

行键读取的内部边界 ​

应用通过公开 rowKey 字段名或同步回调配置行键，由分页数据与表格完成读取和校验。asamRowKey 的函数声明只通过根入口的 export type * 提供类型查询，不是根入口可调用的函数；import type 配合 typeof 可以描述其签名，不能据此发出运行时导入。内部读取要求自有字符串键或有限数字，拒绝异步/thenable 回调结果；这项内部校验不能代替应用正确配置 rowKey。包未开放内部 paging 模块的深路径导入。

生命周期完整示例还可展开“公开分页行键边界”。通过真实 useAsamPagedData 验证自有空字符串、零、负数、有限小数和同步字符串／数字回调；布尔值、null、对象、缺失或继承键、NaN、Infinity 及重复键产生 response 错误，不发布成功页。async Promise、返回拒绝 Promise 及成功／拒绝 thenable 都必须被同步回调守卫拒绝，拒绝 Promise 不额外泄漏未处理异常。当前页选择的 toggleRowSelection/selectPage 使用相同守卫；非法异步结果不改变选择，恢复同步回调后可以重新选中。运行期非法输入仅用于展示拒绝边界，正常 TS 应按公开同步签名提供 rowKey。

append 与 empty 都是零参数插槽，经 DataTable → AsamTable → 原生 Table 转交，不接收行、loading 或跨页 selection。append 位于表体行之后；empty 在没有当前可展示行时显示，覆盖原生空文本。默认插槽直接放置列，行作用域由 AsamTableColumn 提供。

成功空页未提供 empty 插槽时，公开 emptyText 使用调用方文案；省略或传入 undefined 时保留默认“暂无数据”。未加载、加载中和错误状态保留数据表自有文案， empty 插槽仍优先于空文本。

生命周期示例的“默认列与 append／empty 插槽”可持有和完成空页、成员页及失败请求。未加载和成功空页显示自定义空内容；加载成员后隐藏空内容，附加说明继续显示。成功页随后失败时保留旧行，空内容不覆盖陈旧快照；恢复空页后重新显示。关闭自定义插槽可查看原生“暂无数据”文本，再打开可恢复自定义内容。

固定原生 2.14.7 的 append 顺序随布局变化：fixed 布局位于汇总之前，auto 布局位于表体内的汇总之后。DataTable 与基础表格都通过原生公开插槽委托，不统一重排这一原生差异。生命周期示例保留布局切换，并覆盖空页、成员页、失败保留旧行、恢复空页及移除／恢复自定义插槽。旧候选曾通过的统一顺序依赖私有派生补丁，其原件仅作旧契约历史，不证明当前原生透传契约合格。

局部请求错误插槽 ​

可选 error 插槽仅在当前请求错误存在时调用，接收只读 { error, stale, retry }。 error 与本实例 error 事件中的 AsamDataError 为同一对象，保留 cause、kind、 message 与 notified；渲染插槽不会再次通知 provider。stale 表示保留的数据已过期。

retry() 不接收参数，直接返回现有 reload({ force: true }) 的 Promise，结果为 AsamReloadResult<AsamPage<Row>> 的 success、error 或 cancelled 分支。 重试保留当前查询、分页与选择，不自动重置这些值。

提供该插槽时，自有内容替换整个默认局部错误区；返回空内容也表示主动替换。 未提供时继续显示原错误文字、过期提示和默认重试按钮。无 error 的单独 stale 状态 不调用此插槽；empty、loading 和其他基础插槽继续使用原作用域。基础表格的 empty 内容仍属于独立的空数据展示。

以下完整 TS/JS 示例先制造失败，再等待插槽 retry 的返回结果；成功后可再次制造 更新失败，观察旧结果与模型保留。每次挂载使用独立子 app 和本地 provider。

局部错误定制、等待重试与过期恢复

展开源码
vue
<template><div ref="host" /></template>
<script lang="ts" setup>
defineOptions({ name: 'AsamDataTableDemoLocalErrorExample' });
import { createApp, onMounted, onBeforeUnmount, ref } from 'vue';
import type { App } from 'vue';
import { provideAsamData } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import Child from './Child.vue';
import { createTransport } from './transport.js';
const host = ref<HTMLElement>();
let app: App | undefined;
onMounted(() => {
	if (!host.value) return;
	const transport = createTransport();
	app = createApp(Child, { transport });
	provideAsamData(app, transport.provider, { scope: 'AsamDataTable-local-error' });
	app.mount(host.value);
});
onBeforeUnmount(() => app?.unmount());
</script>

<script lang="ts" setup>
defineOptions({ name: 'AsamDataTableChildLocalErrorExample' });
import { ref, onMounted } from 'vue';
import { AsamButton, AsamDataTable, AsamTableColumn } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { AsamDataTableExpose, AsamDataTableSlots } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { Transport, Item } from './transport.js';

const props = defineProps<{ readonly transport: Transport }>();
const transport = props.transport;

const control = ref<AsamDataTableExpose<Item>>();
const busy = ref(false),
	result = ref('');
const buildPageParams = () => ({});
const transform = (rows: readonly Item[]) => ({ list: rows, total: rows.length });
onMounted(async () => {
	const response = await control.value?.reload();
	result.value = response?.status ?? 'cancelled';
});
async function recover(
	retry: Parameters<NonNullable<AsamDataTableSlots<Item>['error']>>[0]['retry']
) {
	busy.value = true;
	transport.failing.value = false;
	try {
		const response = await retry();
		result.value = response.status;
	} finally {
		busy.value = false;
	}
}
async function failAgain() {
	busy.value = true;
	transport.failing.value = true;
	try {
		const response = await control.value?.reload({ force: true });
		result.value = response?.status ?? 'cancelled';
	} finally {
		busy.value = false;
	}
}
</script>
ts
import { ref } from 'vue';
import type { AsamDataProvider } from '@asam-ui/ui';
export interface Item {
	readonly id: number;
	readonly value: string;
	readonly label: string;
}
export function createTransport() {
	const failing = ref(true),
		calls = ref(0),
		refreshes = ref(0);
	const api = async () => {
		calls.value++;
		if (failing.value) throw Error('演示请求暂不可用');
		return [
			{ id: 1, value: 'ready', label: '准备' },
			{ id: 2, value: 'running', label: '进行' }
		] satisfies readonly Item[];
	};
	const provider: AsamDataProvider = {
		dict: {
			get: async (
				_type: string,
				context: Parameters<NonNullable<AsamDataProvider['dict']>['get']>[1]
			) => {
				context.signal.throwIfAborted();
				return api();
			},
			refresh: async (context) => {
				context.signal.throwIfAborted();
				refreshes.value++;
			}
		}
	};
	return { failing, calls, refreshes, api, provider };
}
export type Transport = ReturnType<typeof createTransport>;

	provideAsamData(app, transport.provider, { scope: 'AsamDataTable-local-error' });
	app.mount(host.value);
});
onBeforeUnmount(() => app?.unmount());

import { ref } from 'vue';
export function createTransport() {
	const failing = ref(true),
		calls = ref(0),
		refreshes = ref(0);
	const api = async () => {
		calls.value++;
		if (failing.value) throw Error('演示请求暂不可用');
		return [
			{ id: 1, value: 'ready', label: '准备' },
			{ id: 2, value: 'running', label: '进行' }
		];
	};
	const provider = {
		dict: {
			get: async (_type, context) => {
				context.signal.throwIfAborted();
				return api();
			},
			refresh: async (context) => {
				context.signal.throwIfAborted();
				refreshes.value++;
			}
		}
	};
	return { failing, calls, refreshes, api, provider };
}

API

属性 AsamDataTableProps

组合契约按分支生效；请同时查看公开类型。

名称说明类型必填默认值
data说明未声明；参见源码与使用正文（数据 / provider 协议）undefined否未知 / 未声明
